measurement.usageScope: unique physical bestO/c2O/c4O/sharedE only; logical Best=E+bestO and AND=E+c2O+c4O may each attribute E, but their sum double-counts E and is not physical usage; no derived usage or cross-pass reuse

inference.inference: deterministic census envelope over shared Gold completions within each case and independently allowed completion sets across cases; no sampling CI, p-value, model independence or future-performance guarantee
